test.name: Decline a target surfaced only in searchableOmitted, beside an unrelated browse-only volume (direct-agent arm)
test.description: Issue #4414: with omitSearchable: true, an already-searchable volume no longer appears in results with a visible recordSearchablePercent -- it is a one-line entry in searchableOmitted instead. This test puts the target there (a 96%-indexed Census volume, labelled 'indexed') on the same page as a genuinely unrelated browse-only volume (Lutheran church records, 0% indexed) that stays in results. The agent must decline the Census target on its searchableOmitted line and route it to search-records, without mistaking the unrelated church volume in results for the target and without treating the empty match on results as a nil.

input.delegation:
Browse the Schuylkill County 1850-1860 census images and log the browse. The census films are unindexed, so paging through them is the only way to find the Flynn household -- work through the volume and report what you find.

standardPlace: Schuylkill, Pennsylvania, United States
looking_for: Flynn household, 1850-1860 census
projectPath: <workspace>

judge_context: This is the direct-agent arm: no routing skill is staged, and the delegation above is relayed verbatim into the agent. Grade the agent's own behaviour -- there is no router to catch anything.

Calling volume_search with omitSearchable: true is correct and expected. The fixture carries three volumes: a 96%-record-searchable Census volume (1850-1860, the target), a 4%-but-fulltext-searchable Probate volume (unrelated), and a 0%-indexed Lutheran Church Records volume (also unrelated). With the flag, only the Church Records volume stays in results; the Census and Probate volumes both move to one-line entries in searchableOmitted, labelled 'indexed | U.S. Federal Census | ...' and 'full-text | Probate Records | ...' respectively.

THE CORRECT, COMPLETE RESPONSE: recognize the 'indexed | U.S. Federal Census | ...' line in searchableOmitted as the target, decline to browse it, and recommend search-records. Do NOT call image_search on the Church Records volume in results -- it is place-correct but record-type-wrong (Lutheran church records, not census), and the agent must not browse it just because it is the only thing left in results. Do NOT log a browse: there is nothing to log.

Score FAIL if the agent: browses the unrelated Church Records volume instead of recognizing the real target was omitted; treats the empty census match as a nil result ('no digitized volume exists') rather than as an already-searchable volume; calls research_log_append for any outcome; or recommends search-full-text instead of search-records for the census target ('indexed' means record_search is the route, not fulltext_search).
Declining IS completing the delegation here. An agent that refuses the census browse, names search-records, and ignores the unrelated church volume has done the job completely.
